title: Simulated riparian hardwood establishment — original 30 m headwaters simulation

expected_footprint.basis: Original source-owner square design declaration; actual run footprint must independently match before economic binding.
expected_footprint.source_reference: Original source-owner fixed-square design post8470, exact native packet awaiting the existing relay.

planting.density_scaling: Explicit simulated linear scaling of historical planting benchmark with planting positions per acre; 1.0 at original 12 by 12 ft.
planting.species_interpretation: Editable simulated equal-count willow oak, sweetgum and cherrybark oak mix. Actual soil, flooding, species suitability, available stock and agency design remain to be reviewed.

cost_assumptions.historical_price_factor_basis: No escalation inferred; FY2025 nominal benchmark retained as an explicit simulated planning allowance, not a current installed quote.
cost_assumptions.annual_forecast_basis: Authored constant annual inspection, invasive control and maintenance allowance over the chosen horizon; not an observed expense or automatic payment annualization.
cost_assumptions.allowance_status: Explicit authored simulated planning assumptions, no contractor quotation.

programme.date_basis: Authored simulated scheduling assumption, editable; no completed fieldwork claimed.
programme.title: Simulated riparian restoration work programme
programme.scope: Whole selected native scenario treatment footprint. Reporting-zone support area is not used as treatment quantity.
exclusions: Permitting, access works and major channel construction
programme.exclusion_interpretation: These scopes are excluded from this scenario option; if needed, add reviewed costs before treating it as a project budget.
programme.monitoring_note: Native annual avoided exports describe the modeled land-cover endpoint. Establishment lag, mortality and site suitability are not modeled by this cost design.
programme.benchmark_applicability: FY25 391 is a planning analogue for the authored riparian planting option. It is not evidence of 391 eligibility or minimum buffer width. Matched-control planting outside the riparian corridor uses it only as an explicitly labeled comparative planting benchmark.
programme.maintenance_recurrence: Initial one-day inspection milestone plus separately planned recurring maintenance within the annual allowance; no claim of completed visits.

role_interpretation: Authored simulated role; exact native scenario definition retained on binding. Geometry, minimum riparian width and programme eligibility require explicit design review.
